summary: Example task retrieves VOSS system info with voss_command running show sys-info.
questions: How do I get system info from a VOSS switch?

answer_card.title: Get VOSS system info
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve VOSS info
  community.network.voss_command:
    commands: show sys-info
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.voss'
```
